milestones.title: Make passwords visible on demand and validate signup fields during input
milestones.why: Make mobile and tablet sign-in usable and show username and password feedback immediately, without waiting for blur or a completed signup attempt.
changes: Add independent, labeled reveal/hide buttons with 44px targets for sign-in/signup passwords and signup confirmation; preserve values and mask them again on mode changes, submission, reset, and page exit.
Require a unique username for new registrations and guest conversions while preserving existing username-less accounts and learning data.

Check username format and availability as input changes through an invitation/member-protected, no-store endpoint with its own persistent rate budget. Cancel old lookups, ignore stale responses, and keep error or rate-limit states distinct from availability.
Recheck username uniqueness inside the existing registration transaction. Report a final conflict without consuming the invitation or verified email proof so another name can be chosen.

Update password length, advisory strength, and confirmation matching on every input, including the first character. Use pinned, self-hosted zxcvbn locally without password-check requests or new complexity rules.

Verify actual native Chromium typing and touch input, signup conflict/retry, masking, and both themes at 320-1440 CSS pixels with isolated fixtures. Physical iOS/Safari, real email delivery, live CAPTCHA, and hosted deployment are not implied. This milestone is not yet linked to a commit.

milestones.title: Compact the workspace and align navigation and playback controls
milestones.why: Reclaim space for lessons and notes by reducing component dimensions rather than text size, and make navigation and playback actions consistent.
changes: Restore normal text sizes while reducing sidebar widths, taskbar height, desktop control padding, and notes spacing; retain readable text, focus outlines, and mobile touch targets.
Keep narrow notes formatting in one horizontally scrollable row, use labeled native heading choices, and retain the selected heading when editor focus leaves.
Move Notes and the disabled Ask placeholder beside Mark complete below the video. Remove the course-tools rail so closing Course content leaves no reserved left column.

Place the navigation toggle before the app logo on signed-in screens. Workspace collapse retains navigation icons; expansion reveals labels below the unchanged taskbar, with keyboard and backdrop dismissal.
Align both workspace and course-content toggles with the collapsed sidebar centerline without shifting the logo or shrinking their tap targets.
Use one consistent resume indicator while paused. Synchronize the toolbar icon from playback events and periodic checks, clear stale overlays when buffering, and allow Pause during buffering.
Preserve independent layout preferences, existing note data and formatting, Read/Edit mode, autosave, source links, and completion behavior. Ask remains Coming soon without an AI workflow.

Verify responsive geometry, native mouse/touch and keyboard actions, note persistence, and light/dark themes with isolated browser fixtures. Local port 3002 was updated with existing data and runtime settings preserved; physical iOS/Safari and live YouTube playback remain unverified. Branch membership is not proof of hosted deployment.

milestones.title: Make player controls usable across the full touch target
milestones.why: Speed, quality, and caption controls on phones and tablets should not require precise taps on a small dropdown arrow.
changes: Keep controls visible through touch release and native select interaction, then resume the hide timer after a value is chosen.
Use 44px player touch targets and wider speed and quality selects; let compact toolbars scroll horizontally without shrinking controls.
Reveal hidden player controls on the first video tap without pausing playback.
This change initially reduced text to 80%; the later compact-workspace update restores normal text sizes and reduces component dimensions instead.

milestones.title: Refresh the library, player, navigation, and notes workspace
milestones.why: Make finding courses, watching lessons, and writing notes feel consistent on desktop and small screens.
changes: Support light and dark themes, using teal actions and coral brand/streak accents; follow the system appearance until a choice is saved.
Serve IBM Plex Sans, Manrope, and Lucide icons locally instead of a remote font or icon CDN.
Browse courses in Grid or List, combine Pinned with progress filters, and show duration only as precisely as the available lesson metadata permits.
Show YouTube result filters only for keyword searches, preserving library filters and ignoring stale search responses.
Provide a collapsible workspace rail and a focused course rail with Course content, Notes, and a disabled Chat with video placeholder.
Start course panels closed and remember explicit panel choices per account/course without resetting playback or notes.
Keep the paused video visible under light dimming and a centered resume button; hide player controls when idle and retain keyboard access.
Resize notes with drag or keyboard controls. Empty, Read, and Edit states share a borderless mint writing surface inside the blue pane, with theme-aware colors and a focus outline.
Limit optional glass and cursor sheen to navigation; respect reduced motion, reduced transparency, and increased contrast.
Add keyboard-friendly dialogs, compact player controls, chart data tables, and design regressions. Keep Board and video chat explicitly Coming soon.

milestones.title: Add invitation-only accounts with verified email
milestones.why: Control who can join while preserving existing accounts and keeping each member's learning data private.
changes: Create accounts only after a valid one-use invitation and an emailed six-digit code are verified; require matching password confirmation and allow an optional unique username.
Let existing members sign in with email or username without another invitation. Preserve old usernames, account IDs, credentials, and learning data during migration.
Provide a local-only administrator bootstrap command and member invitations from active administrators, with a configurable member limit.
Disable new anonymous guests while retaining export and invitation-backed conversion for existing guest sessions.
Use atomic SQLite transactions, durable rate limits, exact-Origin checks, hashed secrets, and bounded password hashing; back up older databases before authentication migration.
Send codes over TLS-protected SMTP and optionally validate Cloudflare Turnstile on the server. Missing email configuration fails closed for registration.
Keep Google and GitHub sign-in as disabled Coming soon controls, without OAuth or automatic account linking.

milestones.title: Add account settings, password changes, and public policies
milestones.why: Give members one place to manage their account and workspace without interrupting lessons or losing drafts.
changes: Organize Settings into Account, Appearance, Data, Terms and Privacy, and administrator-only sections with guarded dismissal and keyboard navigation.
Save display names and unique usernames; require the current password for a username change and keep the active player and notebook in place.
Allow signed-in members to change a known password. Rotate credentials and revoke old sessions atomically while retaining the current browser with a new cookie.
Retain private JSON export/import and draft protections; never store password inputs in browser storage.
Publish basic Terms and Privacy without requiring sign-in. Keep the operator/legal review checklist and make no compliance-certification claim.
Do not add forgotten-password recovery, arbitrary email changes, or account deletion.

milestones.title: Add private usage monitoring, sanitized logs, and health checks
milestones.why: Help the operator understand application health and coarse usage without exposing members' courses or notes.
changes: Provide an administrator-only view of approximate active members, account activity, origin traffic, process memory, and application storage.
Use short-lived presence challenges and bounded retention; ordinary API calls and delayed learning batches do not count as live activity.
Write rotating structured logs with safe request IDs and route templates, excluding credentials, raw request bodies, email addresses, and learning content.
Keep Prometheus metrics disabled unless a separate token and private host/source boundary are configured.
Include an optional Alloy collector, importable Grafana dashboard, alert rules, and external uptime guidance without enabling cloud export automatically.
Add local application/database health checks and persistent log storage. Do not treat process uptime as proof of external availability.

milestones.title: Refresh the local Docker app without replacing stored data
milestones.why: Resolve the older local image observed on 10 September and run the current frontend and backend together.
changes: The 2026-09-10 check found an old localhost:3002 image without YouTube search; that historical pending item is now resolved locally.
Rebuild the local app on port 3002 with the current assets and matching backend, retaining the existing database and log volumes.
Verify application/database readiness and that served HTML/CSS match the checkout, including the latest borderless notes surface.
Keep production and development deployments unchanged. A feature-branch push is not evidence of a hosted deployment.

milestones.title: Document course downloads as a backend-only capability
milestones.why: Describe the accepted website accurately without restoring previously removed download controls.
changes: The 2026-09-10 review preserved a pre-existing browser download-UI removal whose original reason was not recorded.
The accepted workspace still has no course-download button; document that limitation in the feature guide and PR.
Retain the authenticated, permission-confirmed backend API for installations that provide yt-dlp and ffmpeg. The basic Docker image does not bundle these tools.

milestones.title: Add timestamped course notebooks with collapsible notes
milestones.why: Let learners capture notes against the exact moment in a video without leaving the player, and keep them separate from course progress data.
changes: Add a private per-course notebook with one optional rich-text document per video; opening an empty editor does not create a saved document.
Capture the matching video's playback time as hidden metadata on a paragraph's first keystroke, without guessing from saved progress.
Support headings, bold, italic, lists, links, inline code, and code blocks through a locally served Quill editor.
Add Read mode for jumping to a paragraph's source moment and an explicit Edit mode for writing, preserved across video changes.
Persist notebooks with revision-aware saves and conflict detection, and add a delete endpoint guarded by the same revision.
Extend the JSON export/import schema to version 2 so notebooks travel with a restored profile.

milestones.title: Plan learning and discover YouTube courses
milestones.why: Bring course discovery and day-to-day learning planning into the same library without losing saved progress.
changes: Add status and sprint boards, tasks, course checklists, and ordered roadmaps.
Persist workspace state with revision-aware profile saves and include it in exports.
Search YouTube by keyword with All, Videos, Playlists, and course-focused filters.
Create courses from search results, preserve existing progress, and handle retries and stale searches.
Add search parser regression tests, Docker packaging, and a dedicated usage and API guide.
Preserve the existing browser download-UI removal while retaining authenticated backend download endpoints.
Integrate dev's existing JSON profile import and preserve workspace data on restore, with in-memory database regression tests.

milestones.title: Publish a traceable release timeline
milestones.why: Make the feature history, affected files, commit membership, and outstanding release work visible in one newest-first record.
changes: Provide a standalone HTML timeline with search and stage filters.
Generate commit dates and branch containment from Git rather than treating a merge as proof of deployment.
Keep feature rationale and dated bug or pending-work observations alongside the generated history.

milestones.title: Bookmark courses and filter the library
milestones.why: Keep priority courses easy to find and exclude local SSH material from source control and Docker context.
changes: Add course pinning and a bookmarked-only library filter.
Ignore the local .ssh directory in Git and Docker builds.

milestones.title: Separate development and production deployments
milestones.why: Promote changes through dev before main while keeping deployment environments and their stored data separate.
changes: Add development and production Compose definitions and deployment workflows.
Guard main-branch pull requests so only dev can promote changes.
Update the Tailscale action and add a connectivity check.

milestones.title: Restore a profile from a JSON export
milestones.why: Make exported learning data restorable without replacing account identity or credentials.
changes: Add validated profile import with confirmation and revision conflict protection.
Restore courses, progress, preferences, and activity history from a supported export.

milestones.title: Package FocusTube for local Docker use
milestones.why: Provide a repeatable local runtime with persistent SQLite storage and loopback-only access.
changes: Introduce a Docker image and Compose setup, then simplify them for local use.
Publish the app on localhost:3002 and persist data in a named volume.

milestones.title: Document setup, architecture, and operations
milestones.why: Make the application installable and maintainable with documented workflows, requirements, and limitations.
changes: Add the project README with setup, API, security, and troubleshooting guidance.
Add screenshots of the library, player, dashboard, and profile workflows.

milestones.title: Build the FocusTube learning application
milestones.why: Turn public YouTube playlists and videos into focused courses with durable, per-user learning progress.
changes: Introduce the Node/Express and SQLite application with an authenticated browser interface.
Provide course import, focused playback, completion tracking, analytics, certificates, and optional downloads.

observations.title: Review and verify dev-to-prod promotion
observations.why: A commit on a branch is not evidence that a deployment completed or that a running environment has that revision.
changes: Review the feature PR into dev, then use a separate dev-to-main PR for production promotion.

Before merging the 2026-09-15 account update, configure exact HTTPS origins, trusted proxy settings, SMTP and persistent backups on the target runtime; the existing hosted Compose files do not yet supply the new authentication/mail settings.
Merging into dev or main can trigger the existing deployment workflow. Check workflow results and the running application's revision before declaring either environment deployed.

observations.title: Review the existing Docker base-image findings
observations.why: The editor's image scan reported vulnerabilities in the unchanged alpine:3.24.1 base image.
changes: The observed report contained 2 critical and 7 high findings; this is a dated observation, not a fresh scan or a claim of application exploitability.
Re-scan the current image, assess findings, and test a base-image update separately.
